description: Side-by-side statistics for up to 12 Finnish postal areas, with national benchmarks and percentiles. Accepts names or codes. A null value or percentile is suppressed or unpublished for that area and year (small-area confidentiality), not zero.

places.description: Postal area names or 5-digit codes, 2 to 12 of them, e.g. ["Hervanta", "Tikkurila", "02100"].

year.description: Statistics year; defaults to the newest.

name: compare_areas
title: Compare Finnish postal areas
